 CrowdStrike (CRWD) is Getting Investor Attention — Here’s Why
 Angelica Ballesteros Wed, November 18, 2026 at 7:33 PM PST 2 min read CRWD -12.92% 
 NVDA -12.14%

 Learn more CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) is one of the 10 Stocks Investors Are Rushing to Buy — Cybersecurity Names Dominate 
 CrowdStrike bounced back by 7.95 percent on Wednesday to close at $237.03 apiece, mirroring the rally in technology stocks, with investor optimism bolstered by Nvidia Corp.'s better-than-expected earnings performance in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. 
 Nvidia—widely considered the bellwether for artificial intelligence buildout—said late Tuesday that its net income for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 more than doubled to $65.3 billion from $31.9 billion in the same period last year. Revenues soared 103 percent to $115.8 billion from $57 billion year-on-year. 
 Photo by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels 
 Despite challenges surrounding the company following Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, Nvidia Corp. remained exceptionally optimistic about its business in the fourth quarter of the fiscal period—with revenues expected to grow by 91 percent to $130 billion from $68 billion in the comparable quarter last year. Its optimism sparked investor confidence, helping propel buying on shares of AI-linked stocks. 
 Nvidia aside, CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.'s (NASDAQ:CRWD) rally was likewise supported by a strong buy rating from 40 analysts covering its stock. 
 This week alone, investment firms Stifel Nicolaus, TD Cowen, and Wells Fargo all maintained a buy recommendation on its shares. 
 Wells Fargo issued the highest price target of $300, followed by TD Cowen with $280, and Stifel at $240. The price target range marked a 1 to 26 percent upside potential from CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.'s (NASDAQ:CRWD) latest closing price.
